notes.title: New update with 2 BRAND NEW Levels!
notes.notes:
The 2 new levels are published. Try out the new Construction Site and the new Corner Store level! There are also many minor bug fixes and tweaks to the gameplay that I think everyone will enjoy. I hope everyone enjoys the update, let me know if you come across any issues or have any new ideas for future updates!

-Colby



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42952249/b26008ef70d29b4465d7f08c0f784eefe334d264.png[/img]

notes.title: Update Version 1.1.2 (2 New Levels!)
notes.notes:
Version 1.1.2
-Two BRAND NEW Bonus Levels! (Construction Site and Corner Store)
-Increased ball gravity to make it less floaty
-Increased after touch for the pitcher after they pitch the ball
-Decreased Season Mode games from 5 innings to 4 innings per game
-Added a button at the level select to indicate how to access bonus levels
-Minor bug fixes and performance improvements
-Secret spots are a little bigger and a little more visible
-Changed icon for character skin variation during character customization screen

notes.title: Future Updates and More Levels Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
Now that the game is available on PC and consoles, I'm starting on some more content for the game. After you win the Kickball Kup, it unlocks 4 new bonus levels. I'm working on adding 2 more bonus levels which I'm hoping to get them out sometime this month(October)

Construction Site:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42952249/8f175020a1d2dd81bfdf3cbc5525138bcc140036.png[/img]

Corner Store:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42952249/b26008ef70d29b4465d7f08c0f784eefe334d264.png[/img]

Remember to leave a review, check out my discord and let me know if you want any fixes or any cool ideas of things for me to add to the game!!

[url=https://discord.gg/96CGhKwwCb]DISCORD[/url]

Thanks!!
-Colby

notes.title: Update Version 1.0.3
notes.notes:
Version 1.0.3
-Fixed Scoreboard showing the wrong score
-Can't slide without moving anymore
-Fixed issue where you could run to the wrong base
-Fixed issue where the scoreboard was visible between innings

notes.title: Update Version 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Version 1.0.2
-New VFX For Kicking and Throwing
-New animation for loading up your kick
-Main menu music bug fixed
-No more tie games. All games go to extra innings until there is a winner
-fixed a few bugged achievements that didn't alway pop when they should
-Minor bug fixes with character controls

notes.title: Update Version 0.9.7
notes.notes:
-Toggling Antialiasing should be working now
-fixed bug with ghostrunners not facing the correct direction sometimes
-fixed scoreboard bugs where between innings would show the wrong score
-Tons of minor bug fixes with general gameplay and character controls
-Secret levels have been replaced with Bonus Levels. Win the Kickball Kup at least once to unlock the 4 bonus levels(with more levels to come!)

notes.title: Update Version 0.7.6
notes.notes:
Version 0.7.6
  -added new secret level, an alternate Bedroom Level! (at level select, press CTRL + L to see secret levels)
  -Full controller support 
  -Animation tweaks/fixes for jumping and sliding when fielding
  -Fixed bug in the field where you could get knocked out by a flying object, then hit again right after and the animation gets messed up and you slide along the ground

notes.title: Update Version 0.7.4
notes.notes:
Version 0.7.4
	-added new secret level with blocks for home runs and outs (press CTRL + L at the Room Select screen to see the secret level buttons)
	-added new secret level with an empty baseball field
	-fixed animations for kicker while strafing 
	-fixed bug with kicker jumping while on a base

notes.title: Update Version 0.7.3
notes.notes:
Version 0.7.3
	-added VFX to bases when baserunner is on the base to make it easier to tell if you are on or off the base
	-added yellow outline to kickball when the ball is catchable for an out, outline with disappear when the ball hits the ground
	-attic is properly set to a large field size, other tweaks to close up some areas the ball might become out of reach
	-fixed issue with setting music to 0
	-fixed issue with ball not counting as a catch if hit too hard and fast right to the pitcher
	-fixed issue with ball getting stuck in garden near 3rd base of backyard level
	-fixed issue with bad pitch event occurring and the ball getting kicked at the same time
	-added better looking ball shadow icon

notes.title: Version 0.7.2 Patch
notes.notes:
Version 0.7.2
	-Kicker ai should have more variety in their kick
	-added ball shadow under ball when it’s high
	-raised camera in secret level
	-fielder AI moves around certain obstacles where they used to get stuck
	-added confetti VFX to kickball pop HR

Version 0.7.1 (hotfix 6/2/2023)
	-fixed issue with ball becoming invisible in certain rare scenarios

notes.title: Update v0.7.0 (6/1/2023)
notes.notes:
Version 0.7.0 (6/1/2023)
    -fixed Hi Hungry, I’m Dad achievement
    -actually fixed water break from happening too often
    -AI baserunning decision improvements
    -Improved issue where low kicks are counted as outs even when they seem to touch the ground
    -slightly decreased fielder catching radius
    -fixed running in place during water break
    -slightly increased ball gravity to make it feel less floaty
    -ball shouldn’t get stuck on lockers in classroom and hockey net in basement
    -fixed score issue where run scores before a catch and the inning ends

notes.title: Indoor Kickball Is Available NOW!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

As many of you know, Indoor Kickball released last week! So far the feedback on the game has been amazing! I pushed out a few fixes over the weekend and should have another significant update with some fixes and polishing out in the next few days.

If you are on the fence about the game, [b]it will only be available for 10% off for a few more days[/b], so get it while it's still on sale! It probably won't go for too many more discounts until the console version launches so get it early so you can help with feedback and ideas while the game is still taking shape!

Thanks everyone for checking out the game, be sure to check out our Discord for daily updates and news about the game development progress!

[url=https://discord.gg/96CGhKwwCb ]JOIN OUR DISCORD!![/url]


Thanks Kickballers!!!

-Colby

notes.notes:
Indoor Kickball will be releasing on May 26th at 3PM EST! It's only a few weeks away!!ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Indoor Kickball Dev Log #2
notes.notes:
I recently added more unlockables! You will be able to unlock new kickball skins, like a soccer ball as seen here!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42952249/a3603feb868666d3f30bde3590b3fb7aae086262.png[/img]

I also added more characters skins, like Wendy the soccer player as seen in the screenshot. Each will have 2-5 color variations as well. There are 18 different characters to choose from which will provide tons of customizations with all the dozens of hats and dozens of other accessories to choose from.

I hope everyone is looking forward to the first kickball video game! Please add to your wishlist and let me know what other types of features you would like to see in Indoor Kickball!

notes.title: Indoor Kickball Dev Log #1
notes.notes:
I've been working hard on the season mode and have it almost functional. You will choose a player then play in a 16 game randomly generated season mode. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42952249/f25523bfecdf8bffe24334e1936091bf2b2f6a9c.png[/img]

After the season, the top 4 teams will compete in a playoff game to get into the Kickball Kup championship game!

Progress is still coming along smoothly for release next year. Add to your wishlist and let me know any features you would like to see!
